jobs.title: Intern | Cyber | Cyber Operate | Oman
jobs.description: Intern | Cyber About Deloitte : When you work for us, you commit to a career at one of the largest and most prestigious professional services firms in the world. We have received numerous awards over the last few years, including Best Employer in the Middle East, and Best Consulting Firm, and the Middle East Training & Development Excellence Award. About Cyber : Deloitte offers a fully customizable suite of cyber solutions and managed services. With a commitment to technological innovation and broad industry expertise, our Deloitte global network gives us the insight and experience to face any scenario. Our Purpose Deloitte makes an impact that matters. Every day we challenge ourselves to do what matters most—for clients, for our people, and for society. We serve clients distinctively, bringing innovative insights, solving complex challenges and unlocking sustainable growth. We inspire our talented professionals to deliver outstanding value to clients, providing an exceptional career experience and an inclusive and collaborative culture. We contribute to society, building confidence and trust in the markets, upholding the integrity of organizations and supporting our communities. Our shared values guide the way we behave to make a positive, enduring impact: Lead the way Serve with integrity Take care of each other Foster inclusion Collaborate for measurable impact Overview During your tenure as an intern , you will gain practical experience in cyber security best practices while developing and showcasing your skills in the following key areas: Responsibilities Supporting in client related workshops. Supporting in developing deliverables, including policies and processes with corresponding workflows. Supporting with drafting proposals. Preparing presentations and slide deck. Documenting meeting discussions and identifying subsequent tasks for execution. General Capabilities Builds own understanding of our purpose and values; explores opportunities for impact. Demonstrates strong commitment to personal learning and development. Understands expectations and demonstrates personal accountability for keeping performance on track. Actively focuses on developing effective communication and relationship-building skills. Understands how their daily work contributes to the priorities of the team and the business. Qualifications: Interpersonal Skills: Fluent in both written and spoken Arabic and English. Bachelor’s degree in Cyber Security, Computer science, Data Science or any related fields. 0 to 1 year of relevant professional experience. Strong communication and interpersonal skills with an emphasis on teamwork. Excellent problem-solving abilities. Available for a minimum duration of 3 to 6 months. Technical Skills: Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, especially PowerPoint, Word, and Excel. Familiarity with data visualisation tools such as Power BI and Tableau is a bonus. Familiarity with MS Visio. Familiarity with Data Management, Privacy Gove

jobs.title: ZAIN2533 - Cyber Security Officer
jobs.description: The Cyber Security Officer is responsibile for supporting the organization’s cybersecurity operations by monitoring, identifying, investigating, and responding to security threats and incidents. The role also includes the Implementation and administration of security controls, tools, and processes to protect Zain Bahrain platforms in addition to supporting compliance activities, security assessments, and continuous improvement of the organization’s cybersecurity posture. Administer and improve existing cybersecurity solutions such as XDR, SIEM, Email Security, VA platforms, awareness training platforms, DLP, Threat Intelligence ..etc. Investigate and respond to cybersecurity incidents. Provide awareness training and technical support for users with varying levels of cybersecurity knowledge and competence. Identify vulnerabilities and track them with the relevant owners. Onboard and introduce new security solutions. Participate in procurement, installation, testing and implementation of cybersecurity related security projects. Building and maintaining Zain Bahrain cybersecurity policies and MSB’s. Support compliance and audit activities and various security assessments. Formulate internal security and risk assessments plans and processes. Develop operations work plan to support all operations activities. Perform any other related duties as assigned or needed Bachelor Degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security or any relevant field. 1 to 3 years’ experience in a similar area preferably in the Telecom field. Good knowledge of network and endpoint security, firewalls, SIEM, EDR/XDR, and access controls. Understanding of vulnerability management, security monitoring, incident response, and threat analysis. Familiarity with security frameworks and standards such as ISO 27001, NIST, and CIS Controls. Basic knowledge of cloud security, Active Directory/Entra ID, Windows and Linux security. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills. Ability to analyze security alerts, identify risks, and coordinate remediation with IT and other teams. Familiarity in policy formulation review.
